column3: “To serve you” supplies the purpose of living toward them.
“The test” supplies what is not failed.
“Aim for perfect harmony” interprets being restored; encouragement becomes mutual.
The saints’ greeting is in verse 13.
BSB has here the saints’ greeting (part of verse 12 in the Greek); the blessing of this verse follows in BSB’s verse 14.
BSB has here the blessing that the Greek gives in verse 13; this verse number has no separate Greek text.
